# Leaflet 1.9.4

The stable release listed at <https://leafletjs.com/download.html> was verified on 9 September 2026. The separately listed 2.0 alpha is a prerelease.

The unmodified distribution files are stored locally so the citation map needs no CDN, tile service, account, or API key:

- <https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js>
- <https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css>
- Images from <https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/images/>
- License from <https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leaflet/Leaflet/v1.9.4/LICENSE>

Leaflet is distributed under the BSD 2-Clause License reproduced in `LICENSE`.

SHA-256 checks:

```text
db49d009c841f5ca34a888c96511ae936fd9f5533e90d8b2c4d57596f4e5641a  leaflet.js
a7837102824184820dfa198d1ebcd109ff6d0ff9a2672a074b9a1b4d147d04c6  leaflet.css
```

These match the release integrity values published on the Leaflet download page.
